findings.description: Intentional os._exit(75) bypasses child finally cleanup, leaving its independently allocated edge-gate-owned scratch directory. With reused input spools it normally contains only OWNERSHIP metadata.
findings.recommendation: Either record and remove verified child-owned scratch from supervisor cleanup, or explicitly disclose the small orphan and clean it after retrieval.
findings.resolution: Child writes an exact scratch marker in its recovery attempt; parent bounded_process finally invokes on_exit after child exit. Cleanup verifies marker scope/pid/output and an absolute direct child of scratch_root with the edge-gate-owned prefix, rejects symlinks, verifies OWNERSHIP scope/pid/output, and removes only that directory; no directory enumeration.

findings.description: Controlled recovery outputs use fixed engineering_recovery/baseline and resumed paths. Re-running the gate with the same output after partial/successful recovery reuses existing batches and no longer reaches expected first-batch crash/row counters.
findings.recommendation: Use a fresh bounded recovery-attempt namespace while reusing science input spools, or require a fresh output directory for each independently authorized gate attempt.
findings.resolution: Every main execution generates a fresh 32-character lowercase hexadecimal recovery attempt ID. Baseline, crash/resume commits, scratch markers and logs use that attempt directory. Child phases receive the same validated --attempt-id while scientific input spools remain shared.

read_only_checks: Original selected_snapshots generator preserved; decoder stop_after set to complete raw record count; generator exhaustion plus original final raw SHA and explicit last_frame==records required for full EOF receipt.
Scientific spool binding includes selection seal, runtime identity, scientific artifact pins and raw bytes/SHA; roles are usable only after complete gate.
73 shape groups each use lexicographic first min(16,N_shape) UIDs, with physical singleton cloning separate from logical row counts; no input deduplication.
Actual child exits after first committed batch; same ordered plan/binding reused; all committed files must match uninterrupted baseline bytes; exact reused/new rows checked.
Watchdog shares original absolute monotonic deadline across parent/children; reserved termination budget; one CPU affinity, 8GiB budget, independent node-local scratch checked.
Only saved source CAL16 E3/q14 reach cached/old frozen heads; maximum absolute tolerance1e-4 and four-head exact decisions required; no raw-to-E3 source parity overclaim.
Large-bank distances use fixed seed synthetic features; external encoded throughput outputs discarded except HPC-only recovery batches; no external quality evaluation route in engineering gate.
Separate bound engineering authorization scope and card status required before runtime; formal worker separately requires formal authorization, Linux recovery PASS and independent review PASS.
Final P2 resolutions re-read: isolated recovery attempt and exact exited-child-owned scratch cleanup.
Disk telemetry explicitly records 60-second sampled maxima for output and scratch, without claiming instantaneous peaks.
scope: original selected_snapshots and replay_io EOF contracts
